title: Data Analyst - Human/Social/Health Sciences
text: Data Analyst - Human/Social/Health Sciences at TRS - Public Sector (Sydney, CBD, Inner West & Eastern Suburbs; Contract/Temp; salary: $526.00 - $553.00 + super / day). Data Analyst - Human/Social/Health Sciences The role supports the Manager and works with the other analysts in the team on projects to improve data capability, comprehension, and analysis across the organisation. To be successful in this role you must have a high level of data comprehension, skills in data analysis and strong skills in software to support data analysis and presentation. You must enjoy working within a diverse team, contributing to work on a variety of projects. Selection Criteria:- Recent experience in data analysis and data interpretation - experience in a human services or related area would be well regarded Recent experience in use of data analysis software - such as SPSS, SAS, R or Stata Skills in the use of Microsoft Excel Experience in manipulating data for analysis or reporting purposes Experience in presenting data for use in reports or presentations Ability to interpret findings. Qualifications and recent experience in data analytics, psychology, social science, health sciences, or equivalent experience would be highly regarded. If you meet the above criteria then APPLY now with a current version of your CV
